title: The compressor's reply: what of a task's CCS needs judgment, each with why, read from the repository and the decisions; or the point no file or decision settles, returned to the orchestrator.

given.description: every role the call printed under give, each with the file or decision it rests on

role.description: work: a file or folder the result is made at, one entry each; kind: the kind of work, whose checklists it is made with; receiver: who uses the result at the build stage; use: what they use it for; has: a file or folder the receiver has with it, one entry each; test: the one command that checks the result

value.description: the path, the kind, the receiver, the use or the command, from the top of the repository; null for test alone, where the project has no command that checks it

why.description: the file and its lines, or the decision, it is read from

point.description: a point no file or decision settles, for the orchestrator to ask the user
the question to put to the user, on one choice

why.description: what it rests on: the files and decisions read that settle none of it
